Why it got past before: gate_entry_shape_problem reads only repeated/misplaced suites, and the fix task's files arm handed every path to the spelling unread, so the gate was well-formed and wrong. F674: new _says_no_code_change (positive evidence: 'no code change', 'comment-only', or one clause editing a comment/docstring with no clause join) makes _fix_task_args default gate-only; new _expects_red_first writes expectRedFirst true for a fix task only when tests.add is non-empty (build and scope writers both; planned tasks keep true so the validator nudge stays). Updated pins that encoded the old behaviour: cz13 and the fx-doc ALLOW case now expect (tdd, expectRedFirst false) for a source-only fix with no case; cz17 now names the unit suite in the resolution and cz17b pins the bare-source case (phase gate, phase-no-paths, expectRedFirst false). verbs-in-full.md paragraph on fix-task gate-only/gate updated (outside task files; the plan gate allowed the Edit). Tests: test_drive_phase fx-block 8/8, test_audit_task 1104/1104, whole sweep 194/194 files 16862 cases, ruff and vermin clean.
